title: Natural language to typed function call
description: Turn a natural-language command into a function name plus enum and boolean arguments

functions.description: name and description of each function (params are the caller's to read: see limitations)

function.instructions: Which function does the user want?

extra.no_match: none of the listed functions fits the request

combine: no_match if function == 'no_match' and function.p >= call_p; call if function != 'no_match' and function.p >= call_p; ask otherwise
limitations: only the function is read: the per-parameter questions (a choice per literal, a noul per bool, the inverted claim for negations) cannot be generated by the engine, so argument values, confirm and the both-ways rule stay in the caller
confident wrong reads are possible on negation (0.987)
notes: # deviation: spec 5.10: the engine cannot generate per-parameter questions ($each is score-only), so only the function choice is built; confirm is listed but unreachable; decisions are ordered so a fail-open override gives no_match, never call
